notes: For the Backend account only: a payslip that has already been paid can now be corrected, or cancelled, from the Payroll screen. Correcting one moves no money — the payment has happened — and its day counts are left exactly as they were paid on rather than being re-derived from the current attendance, so opening an old payslip cannot quietly change the figures it was paid on. Cancelling marks the payslip void instead of deleting it: it disappears from the employee's payslips and from the year's totals, but the month stays locked so it can never be generated and paid a second time. Both actions are recorded against the account that made them. Nothing changes for anyone else, and nothing changes elsewhere in the app.
